options.name: component
options.description: Specifies the type of LVM component to report information. A(pv) specifies physical volume. A(lv) specifies logical volume. A(vg) specifies volume group. C(all) specifies all previous LVM components to be reported.

options.name: lvm
options.description: Users can provide the existing LVM facts to which the queried facts should be updated. If not specified, the LVM facts in the ansible_facts will be replaced.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of a LVM component.
